$comment: IA icerik catisi — JabLab library.json desenini uyarlar (M-F-103/108).
Kutuphane -> Calgi sayfasi -> Kurs -> Ders. Her calgi KENDI sayfasi.
DURUSTLUK KURALLARI (mekanik olarak test edilir, tools/validate_library.py):
1. status=coming_soon olan calgida KURS OLAMAZ (sahte kurs listelenmez).
2. Her kursun en az 1 dersi olmak zorunda (bos kurs listelenmez).
3. Ders, ruleset'te BULUNMAYAN teknige atif yapamaz.
4. Her calgida honesty bloku ZORUNLU (neler olculur / neler OLCULMEZ).
5. status=locked olan her ders lockedReason tasimak zorunda (esik degeri DEGIL, EKSIK OLCUMUN adi).
6. Kapsam-disi (comingSoonInThisDiscipline) her madde gerekce tasimak zorunda.

disciplines._why_starter: ONAYLI TASARIMDAN, secilmedi: `Ostinato.dc.html` satir 133-145 + 982-986 'START HERE' seridini UC calgidan UCER ders olarak veriyor ve gitarin kalemi 'Camera and space'. Kimlik burada, EKRANDA DEGIL (kapi: validate_starters.py) — cunku hangi dersin giris kapisi oldugu bir ICERIK karari, ve ekran kodunda gomulu olsaydi gozden gecirilemezdi (ayni gerekce: honesty.instrumentSpecificGap).
disciplines._why_starter_kindNote: Bu ders `guide` sinifinda (focus=setup, olcum iddiasi YOK); san ve piyanonunki `scored`. Uclu AYNI sinifta DEGIL ve bu bir kusur degil tasarimin secimi: ilk adim gitarci icin kurulum, otekiler icin olcumun ne oldugunu gosteren ders. Sinif farki gizlenmedi, yazildi.
disciplines.blurb: Put your phone where it can see you sitting with your guitar. We check your sitting posture against how real teachers sit. This build hears nothing: there is no microphone input, so every judgement comes from the camera.

measured: Trunk alignment while sitting — checked against 7 independent guitar teachers who agree to within 2.24 degrees of each other, and that agreement is attested against the recorded reference we built from them
notMeasured: Anything you play. The chord engine correctly refuses a chord outside the 8 this course teaches (E A D G C Am Em Dm) by name ('not one of the chords this lesson covers') instead of reporting the nearest one that is — that refusal behavior is measured and holds. Whether it correctly NAMES a chord you did play is a different, harder question, and as of 2026-08-19 the honest answer is not good: run against real recordings of a different guitarist playing rhythmic accompaniment (three independent takes, major and minor chords both, 150 windows), it named the right chord in only 15.3% of them — far short of the 90% this course would need before grading you on it. It has only ever run on those recordings. There is no microphone input in this build, so none of it runs in your room, and even the discouraging number above is someone else's playing, not yours.
Arm and hand position while holding the guitar — teachers disagree about this by style (11-18 degrees apart), we show it but do not grade it (M-O-46)

Finger placement or fretting technique — the camera does not resolve fingers well enough to grade them. At the distance that keeps your hips in frame, a fingertip is a few pixels wide, so there is nothing stable to measure.

Strum timing — NOT measured. We can hear individual note attacks, but a strum is one gesture producing six near-simultaneous ones, and the step that maps those onto a chord does not exist. Until 2026-08-04 this line claimed the timing was measured and merely ungraded; that was wrong, and the config carried a matching dead gate.
Full note-by-note transcription — we recognise the chord class, not every note played

Chords beyond those 8 — we do not name them. Until 2026-08-04 we did something worse than not naming them: a played Bb was reported as 'Dm' in 28 of 29 windows, confidently, because the engine was only allowed to consider the 8 chords of the drill. It now weighs all 24 chords and refuses when the winner is not one this lesson teaches.

honesty._chordAccuracyMeasured: 2026-08-19 (O-179/O-180/O-182, GuitarSet CC BY 4.0 gerçek kayıt, HTTP-range lazy-zip çıkarma ile indirildi — bkz. tool/fetch_guitarset_fixtures.py): 'chord engine is real and measured' cümlesi şimdiye kadar yalnız REDDETME davranışını (yukarıdaki _openSetFix, Bb→Dm düzeltmesi) kastediyordu — kapsam-İÇİ tanıma doğruluğu (kullanıcının GERÇEKTEN çaldığı akoru doğru adlandırıyor mu) hiçbir zaman gerçek sesle sınanmamıştı, yalnız sentetik/yakın-mikrofon spike'larıyla. Şimdi ÜÇ bağımsız GuitarSet take'inden (farklı çalgıcı/tempo/anahtar/tarz — 2 Bossa Nova + 1 Caz) ölçüldü. Bu dersin 8 akorunun TAMAMI üçlü (triad) olduğundan burada rapor edilen sayı roadmap §11'in harfiyen 'major/minor TRIAD' eşiğiyle örtüşüyor: majör+minör üçlü, 150 pencere → **%15,3 doğruluk**, ürünün kendi %90 iç hedefinin ÇOK altında (ChordDetector'ın ayrıca desteklediği ama bu dersin ÖĞRETMEDİĞİ dominant7 kalitesi, 20 ek pencerede TAM SIFIR çıktı — o sayı bu dersin iddiasına dahil değil, tam kanıtta ayrı raporlanıyor). Kök neden teşhisli, gizem değil: kaçırmaların çoğu dedektörün KENDİ güven kapısının (minScore/minRunnerUpMargin) tahmin etmek yerine doğru şekilde reddetmesi (sessizlikten değil — RMS zarfıyla ölçüldü, gerçek yapılı sinyal), kalanı bilinen bir yakın-üçlü karışıklığı (iki akor 3 nottan 2'sini paylaşıyor, ör. G#maj↔Fm) ile aynı-kök majör/minör-üçüncü belirsizliği (ör. Bm↔B7) arasında bölünüyor. Önemli kapsam notu: GuitarSet'in comping stili (senkoplu kısa vuruş) bu dersin asıl istediğinden (tek akoru TUTMAK) daha zor, farklı bir sinyal — yukarıdaki sayı 'dersin kendisinde nasıl davranacağı'nın birebir simülasyonu DEĞİL, 'daha zor bir sinyalde nasıl davrandığı' diye okunmalı; üç bağımsız take'in (iki farklı tarz dahil) benzer sonuç vermesi bunun tek-dosya tesadüfü olmadığını doğruladı. Tam kanıt: docs/evidence/production-line/audio-model-gate.json chordResults+byQuality+allQualitiesMeasured. Eşik/algoritma ayarlaması BİLEREK denenmedi — bu örnekleme göre fit etmek, daha geniş/temsili gerçek veri olmadan ilkesiz olurdu (C8 pitch bulgusuyla aynı disiplin).

courses.goal: Set up your space, sit the way real guitar teachers sit, and learn which eight open chords this course covers. Your posture is checked live; the chord work is described, not heard — there is no microphone input in this build.

lessons.displayName: Holding the guitar — measured, never graded
lessons.demoOnlyReason: You see the range the teachers we recorded occupy for elbows and forearms, next to a figure of your own trunk. What you do NOT see is your own elbow angle: there is no live elbow measurement in this build, which is also why the arms in that figure are drawn as dashed lines and carry no joint dots. And even with it you would not get a mark, because there is nothing honest to mark you against.

promotionPath.blockedBy: The elbows and forearms of the teachers in our reference spread across 39 to 105 degrees. A tolerance built from that spread would call almost nothing an error, and a tighter one would call ordinary style an error.
promotionPath.unblockedBy: A measurement that separates style from mistake on this joint chain — e.g. a harvest where takes are labelled by teaching intent, so agreement can be computed within intent rather than across it.
promotionPath.ifItStaysBlocked: The lesson stays exactly as it is: measurement shown, no mark. That is a legitimate permanent resting state, not a failure — but we do not declare it permanent, because the camera CAN see these joints. What is missing is consensus, not sight.

lessons._why_not_permanent: M-F-245 sozlugu: `permanent` KAMERANIN GOREMEDIGI kalite boyutu icindir. Kol acilarini kamera GORUYOR ve olcuyoruz — eksik olan uzlasi. Bunu `permanent` ilan etmek, olcum bosluguyla kategori farkini karistirmak olurdu (kamera-korlugu != uzlasi-yoklugu).
lessons._why_not_locked: Kilitli ders hicbir yuzey tasimaz; oysa bu olcum GERCEKTEN yapiliyor ve durustluk kutusu kullaniciya zaten 'gosteriyoruz ama puanlamiyoruz' diyor. Kilitlemek, yaptigimiz olcumu saklamak olurdu.
lessons._supersedes: 2026-08-04: bu ders KILITLIYDI. lockedReason'i zaten dogru seyi soyluyordu ('11-18 derece ayri tutuyorlar, bu stil, puanlanacak dogru yok') ama KILIT yanlis araci: olcum gercekten yapiliyor ve durustluk kutusu kullaniciya 'gosteriyoruz, puanlamiyoruz' diyor. demoOnly/structural-circular tam bu durum.
lessons._priorLockedReason: We can see your arms but we deliberately do not grade them. The three teachers we measured hold the guitar 11-18 degrees apart from each other — that is style, not error, so there is no honest 'correct' to score you against. This lesson opens only if a measurement is found that separates style from mistake.
lessons._demoOnlyReason_fixed: 2026-08-07 (O-055): onceki metin 'You see your own elbow and forearm angles, LIVE' diyordu. Canli dirsek olcumu YOK — `lesson_demo_screen.dart` sercesi bunu zaten soyluyor ('when this is live') ve figurun kollari tam bu yuzden KESIKLI ciziliyor. Ekran durusttu, ICERIK degildi.

lessons.lockedReason: Nothing below your hips is measured. Our posture reference is built from upper-body landmarks only, because guitar teaching footage is filmed waist-up — knees and ankles are usually not in frame at all. Without leg landmarks we cannot tell a footstool from a crossed leg.

promotionPath.unblockedBy: A posture reference harvested from footage that actually includes legs. Ours is built waist-up because that is how guitar teaching is filmed, so this is a new harvest — not a threshold we could derive from what we already have.

lessons.lockedReason: Chord recognition was proven on synthetic audio (8/8 chords, zero false judgements) — and as of 2026-08-19 it has also been measured on real guitar recordings, three independent takes, 34 real chord samples. The result was not good: 15.3% accuracy on the triad chords this course actually teaches, far short of the 90% we would need before grading you on it. The gap is not a mystery: most misses are the engine correctly refusing rather than guessing on a harder signal than this drill asks for (a professional's rhythmic comping, not the single held chord you would strum and sustain), and the rest split between a couple of specific chord pairs it confuses. We won't grade you against a measurement that keeps failing on real playing, however well we understand why it fails.
lessons._lockedReason_source: 2026-08-19 (O-179/O-180/O-182, GuitarSet CC BY 4.0): docs/evidence/production-line/audio-model-gate.json chordResults.roadmapGate (triad-only, 150 windows, 0.1533) + $representativenessCaveat. Aynı sayı guitar disiplininin kendi honesty.notMeasured metnine de yazıldı (O-181/O-182).

promotionPath.unblockedBy: A real accuracy improvement measured on real playing, not a threshold retuned to fit one dataset — the honest path is more representative fixture data (ideally an isolated held-chord recording closer to what this drill actually asks for, since every available real dataset so far is rhythmic performance) before any code changes to the shared detector. There is still no microphone input in this build either, so accuracy is not the only gate.

lessons.displayName: Light, distance, and when we refuse
lessons._why_unlocked: OLCUM IDDIASI YOK — saf yonerge dersi (camera_space ile ayni sinif). Hicbir metrige, referansa veya kapiya bagli degil. Icerigi UYDURULMADI: setup_check_screen.dart'in GERCEK asamalarini (framingError · lowLight · ok) ve onlarin ekranda yazili gerekcelerini anlatir — yani kullanicinin zaten karsilasacagi davranisin izahi.

lessons.lockedReason: Blocked twice over, and either block alone would be enough. First: a strum is one gesture that produces six near-simultaneous note attacks, and the step that maps those attacks onto a single chord event does not exist. Second: even with that step built, we have no teacher data on how far off the beat counts as a mistake for strumming — so there would be nothing to compare you against. We will not open this on a number we invented.
lessons._why_locked_source: guitar.comingSoonInThisDiscipline[0] + honesty.notMeasured (strum timing). Bu ders YENI bir iddia getirmiyor, var olan iki adli engeli kendi sayfasina cikariyor.

promotionPath.unblockedBy:
Two separate things, and both are needed: the step that maps six near-simultaneous attacks onto one chord event, and teacher data on how far off the beat counts as a mistake when strumming. Building only the first would give us a number with nothing to compare it to.

There is no microphone input in this build, so this lesson is blocked twice over: the measurement is unconfirmed, and there is no way to listen to you even if it were.

lessons.lockedReason: This course teaches eight open chords, and the engine now refuses anything else by name. It did not always. Until 2026-08-04 a played Bb came back as 'Dm' in 28 of 29 windows — confidently — because the engine was only allowed to consider the eight chords of the drill, so the nearest of the eight always won. It now weighs all 24 and refuses when the winner is not one this lesson teaches. Opening a lesson on the other sixteen would mean grading you against a recogniser we have not measured on them.
lessons._why_locked_source: guitar.honesty.notMeasured (Bb->Dm, 28/29 pencere). Sayilar SATIRDAN alindi, yeniden olculmedi.

promotionPath.unblockedBy:
Measuring the recogniser on the other sixteen chords the way we measured these eight — per chord, counting false names, not an overall accuracy figure. An average would hide exactly the failure we already fixed once.

There is no microphone input in this build, so this lesson is blocked twice over: the measurement is unconfirmed, and there is no way to listen to you even if it were.

comingSoonInThisDiscipline: Strum timing as a graded skill — blocked twice over: the strum-to-chord alignment step is not built, and no teacher data exists on how far off the beat counts as a mistake

Elbow and forearm angle as a graded skill — the seven teachers we measured hold the guitar 39 to 105 degrees apart there. That is style and camera angle, not error, so a grade would punish a choice. Shoulder and upper-arm angle are a different case: those two agree as tightly as the trunk angle we do grade. What blocks them is not disagreement but side identity — our recordings do not tell us reliably which arm is which, and a left/right mix-up would mark the wrong side.

Named posture coaching (the 'you are slouching' cue) — the threshold is derived from the reference (14 degrees, the spread inside which any two recordings count as the same way of sitting), but the question of whether a measurement may be spoken as a correction is open, and it is not ours to close: it needs a movement-science review we have not commissioned.

Hicbir tuketicisi yoktu; bu bir PLANLAMA notu, urunun okudugu bir veri degil. `_` on eki onu KAYIT alani olarak isaretliyor — yani 'okunmuyor' artik bir kusur degil bir BEYAN. Sinifini yazmak, sessizce birakmaktan farkli: oksuz anahtar kapisi artik onu dogru sinifla gecirir.
disciplines._comingSoon2_reworded: 2026-08-07 (O-068): 'two teachers' ifadesi KAYNAK SAYIMI gibi okunuyordu, oysa esigin TANIMIYDI (ikili karsilastirma). Ayni kelimeler iki ayri sinif; kapi ayiramadigi icin METIN netlestirildi — kurali gevsetmek yerine ifadeyi duzeltmek.
disciplines._armClaimNarrowed: 2026-08-07 (O-073, JabLab'in 'imkansiz kutusunu sina' dersi): onceki satir 'Arm/hand posture as a graded skill … this MAY NEVER become gradeable' diyordu. OLCULDU, artefaktin KENDI tolerans kaynagindan: left_shoulder ve left_upper_arm perJointSource=floor + floorBoundShare=1.0 — yani SKORLANAN trunk_tilt ile AYNI imza (dispersiyon serbest tabanin altinda). 39-105 derece acikligi DIRSEK ve ONKOL icin olculmustu; iddia 'kol/el postürü' diye BUNDLE edip iki eklemi haksiz yere gomuyordu. 'Asla' bir TAAHHUTTUR ve olcmeden verilirse bir isi SESSIZCE GOMER. measured: Trunk alignment while you set up to sing — checked against 6 independent voice teachers who agree to within 1.35 degrees of each other, and that agreement is attested against the recorded reference we built from them. The reference covers posture during singing too, but this build cannot tell when you start: that phase opens on periodicity in the sound, and there is no microphone input here.
notMeasured: Whether the room is quiet enough and your voice is loud enough to judge at all. The gate that refuses rather than guessing is built and exercised on recordings, but there is no microphone input in this build, so it never runs on your room. The setup check says the same thing in its own words, and shows no progress bar for a capture that does not happen.

Pitch accuracy and steadiness while singing — the engine works and is measured, but it has only been confirmed on real CELLO audio, never on a real singing voice. Locked until it is (see the Sustained note lesson).
Vibrato — measured, never judged. We have no teacher data on what rate is 'right', and inventing one would be a guess dressed as a measurement.
Arm, shoulder and elbow position — the six teachers disagree with each other by 43 to 88 degrees on these. That is style and framing, not error, so we show them and never grade them.

Anything below your hips, and your head and jaw — voice teaching footage is filmed waist-up, so knees are usually not in frame, and our posture reference carries no head landmark. This is why we cannot name the posture mistakes teachers actually talk about (locked knees, lifted chin).
Breath support, larynx position, tongue root — not visible to a camera at all. They are in our error library and deliberately out of product scope.

measured: Trunk alignment while you sit — checked against 3 independent piano teachers who agree to within 1.09 degrees of each other, the tightest agreement of any instrument we have measured, and that agreement is attested against the recorded reference we built from them
notMeasured: Note timing in your room. The timing measurement is real and was made on a recording (AF-008-five-note-timing); it has never run live, because there is no microphone input in this build. The line below explains why it would still not be graded even if it did.

Note timing as a GRADE. We measure it for real (AF-008-five-note-timing), and that measurement is exactly what rules out grading it: the engine reads a perfectly-on-beat note as 8.3 ms early, and that bias falls unevenly — the same 40 ms error reads as 49 ms when you rush and 31 ms when you drag. Grading on that would punish rushing harder than dragging for no musical reason.

Wrists, fingers and hand shape. The pose model does give us a wrist point and three coarse hand points per side (index, pinky, thumb), but nothing that resolves a finger joint — and a collapsed wrist is a shape, not a point. We have never built a hand metric on top of those points and we have no teacher data on what a good wrist looks like, so this is blocked on two things at once: a measurement we have not built, and a reference nobody has collected.

Shoulder tension — the mistake teachers name most often for piano (5 independent channels). We can see shoulders but the three teachers' shoulder angles differ by 24 vs 5 degrees between left and right, and 'shoulders rising toward the ears' is a height, not the angle we hold. Naming it would be guessing.
Elbow distance from the body — measured, but the three teachers' elbow angles spread across 20 to 77 degrees. That is noise, not a threshold.
Bench height, pedalling, evenness of touch, note reading — either blocked on the same missing tools or outside what a camera can see.

Even with one, we could not turn those numbers into a mark — no piano teacher data exists on how far off the beat counts as a mistake, and our own timing engine reads a perfect note as 8.3 ms early with a bias that falls harder on rushing than on dragging.
lessons._why_locked_detail: M-O-65: PLAY fazinin note_timing_ms quality kapisi INDIRILDI. Iki kusur ust usteydi — (1) kapi URETILMEYEN bir metrige bakiyordu (MetronomeAligner koduna hicbir fixture bagli degildi), (2) bar (50 ms) UYDURMAYDI. Simdi metrik gercekten olculuyor (AF-008) ama bar hala yok: postur referansi EKLEM olcer, zamanlama olcmez.
lessons._audioClaimFixed: 2026-08-07 (O-046): onceki metin 'We can hear every note you play — you will see those numbers' diyordu. O-040'in BESINCI ornegi: lockedReason da OLUMLU bir yetenek iddiasi tasiyabiliyor ve kural C yalnizca measured+blurb bakiyordu. Olgu korundu, MEKAN duzeltildi.

promotionPath.unblockedBy:
Teacher data on what counts as off the beat, and a fix for the engine's asymmetric bias (it reads a perfect note 8.3 ms early, and unevenly). Both are measurement work, not opinions we could settle ourselves.

There is no microphone input in this build, so this lesson is blocked twice over: the measurement is unconfirmed, and there is no way to listen to you even if it were.

lessons.demoOnlyReason: You see the range the teachers we recorded occupy for elbows and forearms, next to a figure of your own trunk. What you do NOT see is your own elbow angle: there is no live elbow measurement in this build, which is also why the arms in that figure are drawn as dashed lines and carry no joint dots. And even with it you would not get a mark, because there is nothing honest to mark you against.

promotionPath.blockedBy: The elbows and forearms of the teachers in our reference spread across 20 to 77 degrees. A tolerance built from that spread would call almost nothing an error, and a tighter one would call ordinary style an error.
promotionPath.unblockedBy: A measurement that separates style from mistake on this joint chain — e.g. a harvest where takes are labelled by teaching intent, so agreement can be computed within intent rather than across it.
promotionPath.ifItStaysBlocked: The lesson stays exactly as it is: measurement shown, no mark. That is a legitimate permanent resting state, not a failure — but we do not declare it permanent, because the camera CAN see these joints. What is missing is consensus, not sight.

lessons._why_not_permanent: M-F-245 sozlugu: `permanent` KAMERANIN GOREMEDIGI kalite boyutu icindir. Kol acilarini kamera GORUYOR ve olcuyoruz — eksik olan uzlasi. Bunu `permanent` ilan etmek, olcum bosluguyla kategori farkini karistirmak olurdu (kamera-korlugu != uzlasi-yoklugu).
lessons._why_not_locked: Kilitli ders hicbir yuzey tasimaz; oysa bu olcum GERCEKTEN yapiliyor ve durustluk kutusu kullaniciya zaten 'gosteriyoruz ama puanlamiyoruz' diyor. Kilitlemek, yaptigimiz olcumu saklamak olurdu.

Icerigi UYDURULMADI: setup_check_screen.dart'in GERCEK asamalarini (framingError · lowLight · ok) ve onlarin ekranda yazili gerekcelerini anlatir — yani kullanicinin zaten karsilasacagi davranisin izahi.

lessons.lockedReason: This is the mistake piano teachers name most often — five independent channels raise it. We can see your shoulders, and that is exactly why we will not judge them: 'shoulders rising toward the ears' is a HEIGHT, and what we measure is an ANGLE. On top of that our three teachers' own shoulder angles differ by 24 degrees on one side and 5 on the other, so there is no agreed position to compare you to. Naming it would be guessing with a measurement in hand.
lessons._why_locked_source: piano.honesty.notMeasured (shoulder tension, 5 kanal, 24 vs 5 derece) + comingSoonInThisDiscipline[2] ('needs a shoulder-height metric we do not have').

promotionPath.unblockedBy: A shoulder-HEIGHT metric — we only measure angles today — and its own reference statistic across teachers. Both are missing; neither is a number we could pick.

lessons.lockedReason: We have no hand or finger landmarks at all — only body joints. Every hand-related mistake in our error library is blocked on that missing tool, not on a missing threshold, and the difference matters: a threshold can be measured from teachers, a missing landmark cannot. Until the model reads hands, a collapsed wrist and a good one look identical to this app.
lessons._why_locked_source: piano.honesty.notMeasured (wrists/fingers, 'blocked on that missing tool') + comingSoonInThisDiscipline[1].

promotionPath.unblockedBy: Hand and finger landmarks in the pose model. This is a missing measurement TOOL, not a missing threshold: no amount of teacher data would help until the model can see a wrist at all.

comingSoonInThisDiscipline: Note timing as a graded skill — measured today, blocked on two things: teacher data about what counts as off-beat, and a fix for the engine's asymmetric bias
Everything involving hands and fingers (wrist collapse, flat fingers, hand shape) — blocked on hand landmarks, a missing measurement tool rather than a missing threshold
Shoulder tension, the mistake piano teachers name most — needs a shoulder-height metric we do not have, plus its own reference statistic
